item.title: BIRTHDAY BHOY MARTIN – 74 TODAY – AND THE LAST IBROX HURRAH
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL will celebrate his 74th birthday in the unlikely setting of a hostile Ibrox this afternoon. For a man recognised as a winner, this is yet another encounter to test his credentials. Celtic go into the match in the realisation a victory would give them a point advantage AND a game in hand on Danny Rohl’s side. [...]

item.title: CONFIRMED: SINISALO, OX START
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL has given the nod of approval for Viljami Sinisalo to start against Rangers at Ibrox this afternoon. The Finnish shotstopper was outstanding in Celtic’s 1-0 Europa League win over VfB Stuttgart on Thursday and keeps the No.1 position ahead of Kasper Schmeichel.
